arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse
from decimal import Decimal

print('Final verification of all requirements:')
print()

# R1
print('[R1] dt_format_to_regex exposed:')
assert 'dt_format_to_regex' in dir(parse)
print(f'  OK - function exists')

# Parser handles single-digit days/months via dt_format_to_regex
pattern = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%d/%m/%Y')
r = parse.search(pattern, '5/3/2023')
if r:
    print(f'  Single-digit d/m works: {r.fixed}')
else:
    print('  Single-digit d/m does not match (expected with search on raw pattern)')

# Colons in time formats  
p = parse.compile('{tt}')
r = p.parse('10:30:45.123')
assert r is not None
print(f'  Time with colons and microseconds: OK')

# Flexible %z handling
for tz in ['+0530', '-08:00', '+00']:
    p = parse.compile('%z')
    r = p.parse(tz)
    if r:
        print(f'  TZ {tz}: {r.fixed[0]}')

# R2
print()
print('[R2] Public API:')
for name in ['FixedTzOffset', 'RepeatedNameError', 'date_convert', 'extract_format']:
    assert hasattr(parse, name), f'{name} missing'
    print(f'  {name}: OK')

# R3
print()
print('[R3] formatter property:')
p = parse.compile('{x:f}')
fmt = p.formatter
assert isinstance(fmt, dict)
print(f'  formatter: {type(fmt).__name__}, keys={list(fmt.keys())}')

# R4
print()
print('[R4] Microseconds with various digit counts:')
p = parse.compile('{ti}')
for s in ['.1', '.12', '.123', '.1234', '.12345', '.123456']:
    ts = f'2023-01-15 10:30:45{s}'
    r = p.parse(ts)
    assert r is not None, f'Failed: {ts}'
print('  All pass')

# R5
print()
print('[R5] Hyphen-minus in field names:')
r = parse.parse('{field-name}', 'hello')
assert r['field-name'] == 'hello'
print(f'  field-name: {r.named}')

p = parse.compile('{my-field:n}')
r = p.parse('1_000')
assert r['my-field'] == 1000
print(f'  my-field with n type: {r.named}')

# R6
print()
print('[R6] Grouping characters:')
tests = [
    ('{:f}', '1_000.500', 1000.5),
    ('{:f}', '1,000.500', 1000.5),
    ('{:F}', '1_000.500', Decimal('1000.500')),
    ('{:n}', '1_000_000', 1000000),
    ('{:n}', '1,000,000', 1000000),
]
for fmt, val, expected in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, val)
    assert r is not None and r.fixed[0] == expected, f'{fmt} {val} failed'
    print(f'  {fmt} {val} -> {r.fixed[0]}')

print()
print('ALL CHECKS PASSED')
"
